name: Danganronpa: Grand Lie
source:
Six Ultimates wake up in a Hotel, 
a crime and sin, they all have brought.
Shall they go mad in these cells?
For the only way out is to kill and not get caught.

[From [url=https://collectorsincorporated.itch.io/dr-grand-lie]itch.io[/url]]
